en: In Sirach 2, those who love the Lord are filled with what?
In Sirach 2, into whose hands would we rather fall than human hands?
In Sirach 3, what quenches a flaming fire?
In Sirach 3, honoring whom atones for sins?
In Sirach 3, whose curse uproots a family's foundations?
In Sirach 3, kindness to a father melts sins away like what?
In Sirach 4, which body part should you incline to the poor?
In Sirach 7, besides the living, from whom must you not withhold kindness?
In Sirach 8, which precious metal has corrupted many people?
In Sirach 8, what of sinners must you not kindle?
In Sirach 9, love for a beautiful woman blazes like what?
In Sirach 9, near a man with power to kill, you walk among what?
In Sirach 10, what of the proud does the Lord overturn?
In Sirach 10, man is dust and what else, so why be proud?
In Sirach 10, who is alive today and dead tomorrow?
In Sirach 11, what tiny thing kindles many coals into fire?
In Sirach 13, which beast preys on wild asses in the desert?
In Sirach 13, people extol a rich man's words up to what?
In Sirach 14, under Wisdom's what does her seeker lodge?
In Sirach 16, whose proud neighbors did God not spare?
In Sirach 16, one God-fearing child beats how many godless ones?
